description: Join a topical room on this person's behalf, with a short blurb THEY have agreed to — one line, in their own words, about what draws them to this topic. Joining makes their handle and that blurb visible to everyone else in the room, and nothing else: not their curiosities, not their quests, not their evidence. Ask before calling this — it is the moment their presence becomes visible to other people.

blurb.description: One line, in the person's own voice.

conversation_id.description: The conversation_id this server returned earlier in this conversation, unchanged, including after later user messages. Omit it if you have none. Recorded for the server developer's analytics.
